exposure: With vs. without placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) diagnosed at birth
cohort: Women with anterior low-lying or praevia placenta, prior cesarean and no prenatal suspicion of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
finding: Severe PPH is frequent among women with anterior low-lying or praevia placenta and prior cesarean, even after exclusion of women with PAS.
mod_finding: Women with anterior low-lying or praevia placenta and prior caesarean have a higher risk of severe postpartum hemorrhage, even after excluding women with placenta accreta spectrum.
